andromeda-refactor-orchestrator.description: Primary Codex orchestrator for Rust cleanup, code review, refactor planning, worker delegation, dependency queues, and final consolidation.

andromeda-implementation-orchestrator.description: Primary Codex orchestrator for targeted Rust implementation and improvement requests in Andromeda.

andromeda-roadmap-orchestrator.description: Roadmap-aware Codex orchestrator that consumes global and stage-specific Markdown roadmaps and converts them into queued worker execution.

andromeda-architecture-orchestrator.description: Rust architecture governor for crates, folders, tests, tooling, TDD structure, and mission-critical project shape.

andromeda-readonly-analysis-worker.description: Repository-read-only analysis worker. It scans and reasons over a scoped area and writes exactly one Markdown report under .work.

andromeda-refactor-write-worker.description: Path-bounded write worker for cleanup/refactor/code review corrections. Produces exactly one mission report under .work.

andromeda-implementation-write-worker.description: Path-bounded implementation worker for direct Rust feature/improvement work. Produces one mission report under .work.

andromeda-test-verification-worker.description: Specialized worker for test topology, property tests, fuzzing, Miri, Loom, crash/recovery, CI and validation gates.

andromeda-protocol-contract-worker.description: Specialist for QUIC + Protobuf RPC contracts, ResultStream, payload bounds, and no-gRPC/no-JSON enforcement.

andromeda-storage-wal-worker.description: Specialist for WAL, transaction state, MVCC, storage segments, manifests, binary codecs, recovery and crash-test behavior.

andromeda-srpl-catalog-worker.description: Specialist for SRPL, Type System, ProcedureContract, CatalogVersion, DefinitionBatch, Modelization, Maps and compatibility.

andromeda-codex-tooling-maintainer.description: Maintains Andromeda Codex agents, skills, registries, validation scripts, prompts and .work output contracts.

andromeda-release-mission-critical-revie.description: Repository-read-only report-only reviewer for mission-critical readiness, release gates, C4/C5 risks, and residual work.
